frontMatter.welcome:
Dear Team Member,
Welcome to Ami Lifesciences!
We are delighted to have you join our dynamic and innovative team. At Ami Lifesciences, we are committed to delivering excellence in the Pharma API industry, and your role is integral to achieving this vision.
This handbook has been carefully crafted to provide you with insights into our core values, policies, and the opportunities that lie ahead. It reflects our dedication to fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment.
At Ami Lifesciences, we believe that each employee brings unique skills and perspectives that contribute to our collective success. We are confident that your talents, passion, and dedication will help us reach new heights and make a lasting impact.
As you embark on this exciting journey, remember that you are not just joining a company but a family that values innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. Together, let’s achieve remarkable milestones and create a brighter future.
Welcome aboard! We look forward to supporting you as you grow and succeed with us.
Warm regards,
Mr. Girish Chovatia is the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) and Founder of Ami Life Sciences Pvt. Ltd. With over 27 years of experience in the pharmaceutical sector, he has been instrumental in establishing AMI as a global leader in API production and intermediates. Under his visionary leadership, the company has expanded its footprint across international markets and recently ventured into the nutraceutical field. Mr. Chovatia holds an MBA from Shivaji University and has deep expertise in the pharmaceutical industry, driving new business development initiatives.
Education: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, MBA in Human Resources Experience: Over 21 years in strategic human resource management.

Founded in 2006, Ami Lifesciences is a pure-play specialty API manufacturer based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We address unmet patient needs across therapeutic areas like Cardiovascular, Anti-Diabetics, CNS, and Respiratory, serving over 60 countries. Recognized for our reliability and integrity, we are a trusted partner for generic, Big Pharma, and innovator companies, offering APIs, intermediates, and Key Starting Materials with unmatched quality compliance.
At Ami Lifesciences, we prioritize speed and responsiveness to empower our customers. Nearly 2 decades of expertise in complex API development, coupled with strong IP and regulatory capabilities, ensure timely product launches. With a proven OTIF track record, we are dedicated to fostering long-term partnerships by delivering on our commitments.
We ensure supply chain reliability through process excellence and backward integration, making our products cost-competitive and resilient against disruptions. Our inventory management and timely deliveries provide customers the confidence to sustain their products through their lifecycle.
Our motto, "Driven by Chemistry, Powered by People," reflects our commitment to human potential and health. Guided by integrity, teamwork, and a passion for excellence, we create a work culture that drives innovation and cares deeply for those we serve.
At Ami Lifesciences, we are shaping a healthier future by enabling our partners' success and delivering solutions that improve lives worldwide.

chapters.title: Social Accountability Policy
chapters.text:
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd is committed to protect workers’ right and improve labour conditions and social performance within the organization and in all its stakeholder partnership and relationships.
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd is committed to comply with local national and all other applicable laws and prevailing industry standards.
- Child Labour: ALPL, since inception has followed the practice of not engaging workers who are less than 18 years of age in its workforce.
- Forced of compulsory Labour: ALPL does not engage or support the use of forced or compulsory labour. It promotes an environment for the workforce to work voluntarily, without any threat of punishment or retaliation.
- Health & Safety: ALPL is committed to providing a healthy and safe working environment for all personnel employed or contracted.
- Freedom Of Association: ALPL respects and supports the right to freedom of association and ensures that workers and their organizations are not subjected to any discrimination at workplace.
- Non-Discrimination: In consonance with code of conduct, ALPL provides an equal opportunity to all the employees and qualified applicants for employment without discrimination of any kind. ALPL exercises positive discrimination in favor of socially disadvantaged communities, provided potential employees fulfil their merit-based criteria.
- Disciplinary Practice: ALPL has always treated and will treat all its personnel with dignity and respect. All disciplinary actions are in accordance with law.
- Security Practices: The security of ALPL is practiced ensuring due consideration of human rights under all circumstances.
- Working Hours: ALPL complies with all applicable laws and industry standards on working hours.
- Compensation Practices: ALPL ensures that its workforce is paid wages which meet or exceed the minimum wage as per law.
- Supply Chain Practices: ALPL promotes human rights practices in its supply chain through various engagement forums, training, surveys, third party audits and its inclusion as a criterion in vendor registration process.
- Management System: The Company continuously tracks its human rights and social performance through establishing an effective management system. Any complaint or grievance is addressed judiciously and used as input to further improve the system and processes.
- Collective Bargaining: Worker have rights to join the collective bargaining Organization.
- Young Worker: Ami Lifesciences since inception has followed the practice of not engaging workers who are less than 18 years of age in its workforce. Not engaging young worker in premises.
- NGO Agreements: Organization will do agreement with NGO to handle such cases.
## Quality, Environment, Health & Safety Policy
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd. is a manufacturer & supplier of active pharmaceutical ingredients & intermediates for the pharma industry. We are committed to increasing customer satisfaction by consistently providing quality products that meet current and future needs, continually improve the environment, health and safety in our processes, products, and services.
We are also committed to:
- Comply with applicable legal & other requirements related to quality, environment, health & safety.
## Protect the environment and prevent environmental pollution by
- Reducing and conserving the use of natural resources like electricity, water, steam etc. wherever possible.
- Reduce / recycle / reuse of waste wherever possible.
- Reducing local pollution and impact on biodiversity through adopting the latest technology / monitoring, measuring, and controlling the impact of local environmental pollution
- implement a product life cycle approach across the entire supply chain.
- No complaint from external stakeholders from the operational environment
- Provide safe and healthy working conditions for the prevention of work-related injury & ill health of all interested parties by
- Eliminating and controlling health and safety hazards and its risk by regular medical checkup, inspection of safety equipment, providing suitable PPE at workplace, condition monitoring of workplace etc.
- Enhancing awareness of workplace safety through training, communication, motivation, and their consultation & participation where they exist.
- Control and eliminate business and process risk; and seize opportunities.
- Define and communicate the objectives, targets & its strategy to achieve them to ensure the adequacy of the necessary resources.
- Adopting and promoting process approach and risk base thinking concept among the organization
- Reaffirming commitment to sustainable development through effective implementation and monitoring of QEHS Management System.
This policy is communicated and explained to the entire organization and is also disseminated to all levels of organization through its placement in different communication areas of the company and made available for the interested parties.

## Compensation and Annual Revision Policy
The Compensation & Benefit structure is critical for the Company and will influence our ability to compete for talent over the short, medium, and long term. Since we are a growing company in India, to succeed, our organization must gain and maintain an edge over its competitors, that is, our organization must develop a competitive advantage or superior marketplace position relative to our competitors. Employees are the key Assets for competitive advantage in the global market today. Hence, we may conclude that Competitive advantage can accrue to an organization when the employees are managed effectively. Since Compensation is the prime source of attracting and retaining Talent, therefore, Compensation management is a crucial element to ensure that we have best talent available in the organization.
The company ensures that the workforce is paid wages which meet or exceed the minimum wages laid out legally or as per government standard.
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd is committed to ensuring that all employees receive wages that meet or exceed the legal minimum standards. Beyond mere compliance, we strive to offer wages that are fair, competitive, and aligned with local economic realities. To this end, the company conducts annual wage adequacy reviews, benchmarking employee compensation against industry standards, inflation rates, cost of living indices, and market trends. This review is carried out collaboratively by the Human Resources, Finance, and Compliance teams, who analyze relevant data and present recommendations to senior management for approval.
The company also prioritizes transparent communication by informing employees clearly about any wage adjustments through internal channels. Furthermore, recognizing that economic conditions are dynamic, Ami Lifesciences proactively reassesses and adjusts wages in response to significant changes such as inflation surges or market shifts. These practices reflect our commitment not only to legal compliance but also to ethical responsibility and the long-term growth and well-being of our workforce.
The Company will review pay and benefits annually, and will consider the business climate, financial situation, ability to pay, sales forecasts, market and competitor rates for similar jobs, individual performance, experience, length of service and internal & external equity. We would like to meet the twin objectives of being above market pay for Key position while being efficient, competitive & sustainable in our overall manpower cost. Compensation for employees will be determined based on the following parameters.
- Criticality of the Position
- Position Responsibility
- Position deliverables
- Relevant previous experience
- Performance & Competence
- Qualification
- Availability of talent in market
- Market and competitor compensation level for same Roll
- Internal Equity

chapters.title: Leave Policy
chapters.text:
## Privilege Leave (Pl):
PL Entitlement- 20 days /per year
Maximum number of days to be carried forward per year - 30 days.
The above accumulation of 30 days will be excluding the current year entitlement.
Credit of Leave - Leave will be credited at the beginning of year/ any employee who joins after 1st January during the Year, PL will be credited on pro-rata basis. Other Terms & Condition will be applicable as per Factory Act.
Excess Avail - Upon leaving the organization, employees who have availed PL more than their entitlement; the proportionate deduction shall be made from the Gross salary.
Rule for availing the Leave - PL can be availed Maximum 05 times in a Year. Minimum 01-day leave can be applied. For availing 03 or more PL, employee needs to apply 01 week in advance.
Clubbing of Leave – PL cannot be clubbed with CL, SL, Paternity leave & C-off.
Intervening Weekly- off & Holidays during Leave period - Any weekly off, paid holiday intervening the PL period shall not be considered as PL.
## Sick Leave (SL)
Leave Entitlement-- 10 days /per year.
Maximum number of days to be carried forward per year - 20 days.
Encashment – No Encashment
Over & above 20 days will be lapsed. The above accumulation of 20 days will be excluding the current year entitlement.
Credit of Leave - Leave will be credited at the beginning of year.
Employee who joins after 01st January during the Year, SL will be credited on pro-rata basis.
Excess Avail - Upon leaving the organization, employees who have availed SL more than their entitlement; the proportionate deduction shall be made from the Gross salary.
Rule for availing the Leave - 1/2-day SL can be availed. For availing 03 days or more SL at a time, employee needs to produce medical certificate along with the fitness certificate. In case of availing SL employee must inform his Dept. Head/Superior/HR Dept within 24 hours after proceeding on Sick leave.
Clubbing of Leave - Normally SL cannot be clubbed with PL, CL, Paternity Leave & C-off. In case of prolonged illness PL & CL can be utilized or clubbed with SL, if employee has exhausted his SL.
Intervening weekly-off & holiday during Leave period – Any Weekly off, paid holiday intervening the SL period shall be considered as SL.
## Casual Leave (CL):
Leave Entitlement - 10 days /per year.
Maximum number of days to be carried forward per year – Nil.
Encashment – No Encashment
Credit of Leave - Leave will be credited at the beginning of year/ any employee who joins after 01st January during the Year, CL will be credited on pro-rata basis.
Excess Avail - Upon leaving the organization, employees who have availed CL more than their entitlement; the proportionate deduction shall be made from the Gross salary.
Rule for availing the Leave - 1/2-day CL can be availed. Maximum 03 days at a time. The Employee should get his/her Casual Leave (CL) sanctioned at least one day in advance.
Clubbing of Leave – CL cannot be clubbed with PL, SL, Paternity Leave & C-off.
Intervening weekly-off & holiday during Leave period - Any weekly off, paid holiday intervening the CL period shall be considered as CL.
## Maternity Leave (ML):
Number of days per year - 26 weeks (As per the Maternity Act/or ESI Act). The Maternity Leave will be regulated by the Maternity Act or the ESI Act,1948.
All the above leave is paid leave.
- Paternity leave is applicable to all permanent male employees.
- Employees are eligible for Two Paternity leave for first two days from date of Birth of Child.
- Paternity leave is applicable up to two children only.
## Leave Without Pay
LWP can be applied by an employee when no other leave is available or eligible. A maximum of 30 days of LWP can be availed on the approval of the department head.
## SHIFT CHANGE:
- The monthly shift schedule should be assigned in Online system within 4 working days from the starting of every month.
- Three shift change can be considered in a month for only emergencies not for the routine personal activities which required prior approval of department Head through online system only.
## OFF CHANGE /WEEKLY OFF:
- One Off change can be considered in a month for only emergencies not for the routine personal activities which required prior approval of department Head through online system only.
- Maximum 4 or 5 Weekly off can be considered per month in terms of length of Month.
- Weekly off should be assigned in Online system within 4 working days from the starting of every month.
- Weekly off will be applicable as per Factory act 1948.
- Weekly
- Any weekly off, paid holiday intervening the Absenteeism or LWP period shall be considered as a Absent.

## Attendance Recording and Working Hours Policy
- It is necessary for all employees to record their attendance daily so that the payroll can correctly pay salary to the employees. Through the Attendance Recording System Machines (ARS), employees can record their attendance (clock in and clock out) daily through the attendance recording machine (Face Reading/ Touch Screen Machine) provided at all the location of the Company, Factory, Offices, as per the shift timings. This policy objectives to simplify our attendance recording system while encouraging a culture of trust, integrity, and self-discipline in the organization.
- All employees are required to record their attendance daily (Clock-in and Clock-out at scheduled shift time) in the Attendance Recording System (ARS machines) at provided location, when there is failure of Power, or technical Problem with ARS machines employee need to sign attendance register by marking in and out time.
- As a matter of discipline and punctuality, all employees are expected to be available at work well in time of the start of their shifts. All HOD must seat minimum 8hrs in whole day at any time.
- To take care of unavoidable circumstances (like vehicle breakdown, traffic jams, personal work etc.), any minute late up to 15 minutes will allow 3 times in a month after that it will be mark as a late coming and deduct leave respectively CL, SL& PL. If leave balance is not available than it will be consider as an LWP. It is however expected that employees keep their managers/ colleagues informed of such a delay. Employees may either come late or leave early up to a maximum of 2 hours but on not more than 2 occasions in a month (2 hours maximum each time). Any late coming over 02 occasions as per clause will result in salary deduction for the period of late reporting/ or employee must apply half day leave. This provision is not provided as a Quota for employees and employees are expected to use this option only in case of an exigency.
- Minimum 3.5 hours attendance required on any day to mark attendance for at least half day. Less than 3.5 hours attendance will be treated as full day absence subject to the above-grace period rule consideration. Beyond 2 hours late coming or early going will be marked half day absent.
- If any employee goes outside the office/factory for any official job/personal work during the working hours he/she needs to apply through gate pass i.e., an Official Duty Gate Pass for official work and a Personal Gate Pass for personal work. He/ She also needs to swipe his/her attendance card or mark his/her attendance though ARS (clock out and clock in) while going out and coming back for official or personal work.
- If somebody goes outside the office/factory for official work and does not return to office in case his work is not over by the end of office hour or by the time he would return, the office HOUR would be over. In such a situation he is not required to return to the office just to mark his attendance. The concerned employees can regularize his attendance on the next working day by obtaining the approval/remark of his superior on the gate pass and regularize his attendance online duly approved by his superior.
- If any employee undertakes any Domestic/International/Ex-headquarter Travel. His attendance will be authorized/ regularized by the HR Dept based on receipt of copy tour approval form i.e., the Travel Indent Form & such travel should be authorized by respective HOD Only.

chapters.title: Flexible Working Hours Policy
chapters.text:
- Flexible working hours are available to all full-time employees who have completed their probationary period and have demonstrated reliability and accountability in their roles.
- While flexibility is encouraged, all employees are expected to be present during core hours from 09:00 AM to 5:30 PM, ensuring adequate coverage and collaboration within teams.
- Employees may choose from various flexible working arrangements, including compressed workweeks, flexitime, or staggered shifts, subject to approval by their supervisor and departmental needs.
- Telecommuting options are available for eligible employees, enabling them to work remotely for a portion of their scheduled hours, subject to approval and adherence to company policies and guidelines.
## Eligibility Criteria:
- Suitable roles identified as 85% independent tasks (e.g., coding, data entry, content creation) and only 15% reliant on in-person interactions.
- Minimum performance rating: “Good” or above, quantitatively represented as scoring 3.5 or higher on a 5-point scale in the latest performance evaluation.
- Demonstration of less than 2% error rate in task execution over the past 6 months.
- Minimum performance rating: “Good” or above, quantitatively represented as scoring 3.5 or higher on a 5-point scale in the latest performance evaluation.
- Demonstration of less than 2% error rate in task execution over the past 6 months.
- Employees interested in adjusting their working hours must submit a formal request to their supervisor outlining their proposed schedule and reasons for the change. Supervisors will review requests based on operational requirements and team dynamics.
- Clear communication between employees and supervisors is essential to ensure smooth coordination and workflow continuity. Regular reviews of flexible working arrangements will be conducted to assess effectiveness and address any issues that may arise. Adequate arrangements are made to facilitate communication, such as regular check-ins, virtual meetings.

## Working Hours and Overtime Management:
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd is committed to promoting employee well-being by proactively managing working hours and overtime across all locations.
- Time-Tracking Systems: All attendance data is monitored through our Attendance Recording System (ARS), which captures clock-in and clock-out times to ensure compliance with standard working hours.
- Internal Audits: The company conducts quarterly audits of working hours across departments to identify patterns of excessive overtime or irregular working hours.
- Oversight by Department Heads: HODs must review attendance data regularly and take corrective actions in cases of repeated overtime, including redistributing workload, addressing bottlenecks, and improving planning.
- Legal Compliance: Our processes align with labor laws and internal policies to ensure no employee works beyond permissible hours, promoting work-life balance and employee health.
- Employee Awareness: All employees are informed of maximum allowable working hours, overtime policies, and the importance of compliance through onboarding and periodic training.

chapters.title: Overtime Policy
chapters.text:
- All non-managerial employees (below executive level employee) are eligible for Overtime policy while Management staff (executive and above level) are eligible for Compensatory off as per leave policy. If there are any questions regarding eligibility, please contact HR Department.
- Minimum 2.5 Hrs after working hours will be considered as over time.
- Overtime will be paid as per rule of land (Double payment of basic salary of employees)
- All the logistic arrangement will be responsibility of employees however facility is available then company will provide but not make a special arrangement.
- It is responsibility & accountability of HOD to make sure the smooth working will be recorded and minimum use of overtime as per law.
- Overtime is not connected with regular productivity of the department it is for extra, urgent & for non-expected assignment for company.
- Overtime is accrued when a non-exempt employee works more than normal Working hours in any given workdays. Exceptions may be granted with TOP Management Approval.
## Terms and Conditions:
- All overtime worked must be approved in advance by the Head of Department. This request shall be in writing. Only in exceptional circumstances (e.g., a meeting with a client that runs late, a pressing deadline, Audit etc.) can this request be made at the last minute. The Head of department will evaluate last minute requests on a case-by-case basis. An employee who works overtime without prior approval may be subject to corrective action.
- Whenever feasible, efforts should be made to avoid accruing compensatory time by adjusting the employees' work hours within the same work week.
- Shift Change for Personal work cannot relate to Overtime.
## Remuneration process
## Job Classification and Pay Rates
- Job Classification: Positions in the company will be classified using a structured job evaluation system, taking into account factors such as skill level, experience prerequisites, job intricacy, and physical demands.
- Compensation Structure: Each job classification will be associated with a designated base pay rate, fostering internal equity and conformity with industry benchmarks. Market research and salary surveys may be utilized to ascertain competitive pay rates.
## Compensation Components
The remuneration package consists of the following elements:
- Base Salary: A fixed regular pay rate corresponding to the assigned job classification.
- Shift Differentials: Supplementary pay premiums for working specific shifts, such as nights or weekends.
- Performance-Based Pay: Implementation of incentive programs to reward surpassing performance targets, such as productivity bonuses or safety incentives.
- Overtime Pay: Compensation for employees exceeding their scheduled hours at an overtime rate, as dictated by relevant laws and regulations.
- Benefits: Provision of a comprehensive benefits package, encompassing health insurance, paid time off (PTO), and retirement plans (specifics detailed in a separate benefits manual).

chapters.title: Equal Opportunity Policy
chapters.text:
Purpose With ‘Respect for Diversity’ being one of our core values, Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd has been committed to being an equal opportunity employer. The same is reinforced by our Corporate Business Principles and our Code of Business conduct.
“Our success is based on our people. We treat each other with respect and dignity and expect everyone to promote a sense of personal responsibility. We recruit competent and motivated people who respect our values, provide equal opportunities for their development and advancement, protect their privacy and do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.”
“We embrace diversity and respect the personal dignity of our fellow employees. Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd respects the personal dignity, privacy and personal rights of every employee and is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Therefore, employees must not discriminate on the basis of origin, nationality, religion, race, gender, age or sexual orientation, or engage in any kind of verbal or physical harassment based on any of the above or any other reason. Employees who feel that their workplace does not comply with the above principles are encouraged to raise their concerns with the HR Department.”
We at Ami Lifesciences Pvt ltd committed to do professional development and promotion processes with non-discrimination.
## Scope
The Equal Opportunity Policy is applicable for all job applicants and employees.
## Policy Framework
Ami Lifesciences Pvt Ltd is committed to providing equal opportunities without any discrimination on the grounds of age, colour, disability, origin, nationality, religion, race, gender, or sexual orientation and will not engage in any kind of verbal or physical harassment based on any of the above or any other reason. To this end:
- Our employees are personally responsible for treating each other with respect and dignity, which includes respecting the rights and differences of others.
- Employment with Ami Lifesciences will be based on merit and not on any irrelevant attributes or characteristics that an individual may possess.

chapters.title: Group Personal Accident and Mediclaim Policy
chapters.text:
- The Group Personal Accident Insurance covers any accident occurring during & out-side working hours (24 hours’ coverage), which may result in death, permanent or temporary disablement. This is worldwide coverage.
- This SOP is applicable to all employees at Ami Lifesciences Pvt. Limited, Karakhadi. All permanent employees of the company including Trainees and Workmen who are on the Company’s payroll, to provide risk coverage in case of an accident.
This Policy provides risk coverage in case of an accident of an employee by providing the following benefits:
- Medical Expenses Reimbursement for treatment in case of Permanent or Total Temporary disablement arising out of accident.
- Accident Leave compensation or Weekly Compensation for the period of leave due to accident. (Temporary Total Disablement/or Permanent Partial Disablement as per the GPA Policy Company).
- Compensation to nominee in case of death of employee arising out of accident or Compensation to employee in case of Permanent Total Disablement or Permanent Partial Disablement.
- Other Benefits.
## Reimbursement and Benefit:
- The amount & type of compensation payable will be dependent on the extent of disability. Various reimbursements applicable under the scheme are:
- Reimbursement of expenses incurred toward medical treatment depending upon the policy. In case of Temporary Total Disablement, reimbursement, depending upon scheme of the Insurance Policy.
- In case of death of employee due to accident, the beneficiary/nominee will be paid the total sum assured. The total sum assured will be depending upon the Insurance Policy.
- In case of permanent disablement, the benefits will be paid to employee depending upon the kind of disablement, as decided by the Insurance Authorities.
- If an employee suffers an accident in course of employment or connected with work (this include travelling from residence to office and back, travelling for official work), and is required to take leave of absence & medical treatment.
- The company will grant him paid ‘Accident Leave’ for period of temporary disability and reimburse all medical expenses at actual.
- In all such case any insurance claim amount received under this Group Personal Accident Policy (GPA) towards the leave compensation & medical expenses of the concerned employee will be retained by the Company.
- If an employee suffers an accident outside the course of employment or in a situation not connected with employment and is required to take leave of absence & medical treatment.
- All such accident leave will be leave without pay & medical expenses will be borne by the employee.
- In all such case any insurance claim amount claimed under this Group Personal Accident Policy (GPA) towards the leave compensation & medical expenses of the employee will be reimbursed to the employees as per the said GPA Policy.
- Other Benefits are as per the GPA Policy taken from the Insurance Company.
- The all the benefits under this policy will be as per the GPA Policy taken by the Insurance claim. Complete Group Personal Accident Policy details & procedure for claim & will be as per the GPA policy taken from the Insurance Company.
- If there is any dispute regarding interpretation or meaning of any word or clause of this policy or any discrepancy in types of benefits mentioned in this Policy or the benefits offered by the insurance company, then Original GPA Policy issued by the Insurance Company shall prevail.
## Policy Details:
- Name of the Insured : Ami Life Sciences Pvt. Ltd.
- Insurance Co : Magma HDI General Insurance Co. Ltd.
- TPA : Paramount Health Services & Insurance TPA Pvt. Ltd
- Family Definition : Self + Spouse + 2 dependent children up to 25 yrs.
- Sum Insured Opted : Rs. 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L during the policy period.
- Total Lives Covered : 2827 lives (Emp 1081 + Dependents 1746)
## Policy Coverages:
- Room rent limit: 2% of SI Normal & 4% of SI for ICU.
- Ambulance charges – Covered in case of emergency hospitalization up to Rs. 1,000/-.
- Day care treatments are covered as per as per Magma HDI Day care list.
- Internal congenital diseases Covered. External congenital diseases covered only in Life threatening conditions.
- Pre – Post Expenses covered 30-60 days respectively.
- Specific Disease waiting period waived off.
- 30 Days waiting period waived off.
- Pre-Existing Disease waiting period waived off.
- Internal congenital diseases Covered. External congenital diseases covered only in Life threatening conditions.
- Co-Payment: Nil
- Ayush Treatment: covered in a Government Hospital, on the prescription of a registered medical practitioner only up to 25% of Base SI.
- Donor Expenses covered up to Rs. 50000. Cost of Organ is not covered.
- Lasik surgery covered above +/- 7.5
Liability for Nasal Sinus Surgeries up to Rs.35,000; Hospitalization arising out of Psychiatric ailments up to Rs.30,000.

chapters.title: Training & Development
chapters.text:
## Objective:
To outline the training program approach and describe the procedure to execute it. This training program ensures that employees receive adequate training in CGMP, their areas of work and that the training is documented. It provides a procedure to identify, plan, execute and document the training for personnel engaged in pharmaceutical manufacturing and their support activities.
## Scope:
This procedure is applicable to initial and ongoing technical training of new and existing employees at manufacturing sites of Ami Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. Karakhadi. It covers both permanent and contractual staff.
## Site Training Coordinator:
- Ensuring the completion of On-the-job training of the new employees prior to attending to their routine work.
- Ensuring periodic cGMP training to the existing employees.
- Developing Training Plan for cGMP and Functional training.
- Ensuring the site trainer pool is adequately staffed, through periodic identification and qualification of trainers.
- Facilitating development of training modules and delivering training courses.
- Facilitating identification and development of subject matter experts (SMEs) at site(s) for cGMP, functional and SOP trainings.
- Playing all site administrator roles, along with tracking of employee curriculum progress and triggering escalation wherever needed in AMI Training Information Management System (AMITIMS).
## Department Training Coordinator (DTC):
- Facilitating mapping of SOP specific training requirements for respective functions and support trainer/ SME qualification activities.
- Tracking & monitoring training progress along with reporting, and escalation, as needed, to Site training coordinator/Department Head.
- Playing department training coordinator role in AMI Training Information Management System (AMITIMS).
## nstructor/Subject Matter Experts:
- Will train employees and share associated knowledge.
- Playing trainer role in AMI Training Information Management System (AMITIMS).
## Human Resources:
- Coordinating and ensuring the completion of onsite and offsite Induction Training Program for all the new employees.
- Playing HR Coordinator role in AMI Training Information Management System (AMITIMS).
## All Employees
- Completion of all the assigned learnings within the stipulated time frame.
- Playing Learner role in AMITIMS.
## Procedure:
Process that involves acquiring knowledge, sharpening of skills, concepts, rules, to enhance the performance of employees. Training is an activity leading to skilled behaviour.
## Training Need Identification (TNI):
Process that involves identifying, documenting and assigning the trainings required for an employee job role to acquire and/or upgrade their technical knowledge. This is in order to effectively execute their core job responsibilities, and/ or those which contribute to employee’s personal development.
## Training Information Management System:
Training Information Management System (TIMS) is a software application for the administration, imparting training, documentation, tracking, and reporting of training programs – classroom, online/offline training events, e-learning programs and training content.
## Training of New Permanent Employees:
All new permanent employees engaged in manufacturing, quality control, warehousing, engineering and quality assurance functions etc. shall get basic induction training at the time of joining to the organization as part of employee on-boarding exercise. Employees shall undergo site induction trainings.
## nduction Training:
The objective of site induction training is to make the new joiner familiar with various departments and their functions. Following aspects, but not limited to, shall be covered in the induction:
- Organization and responsibilities
- Environmental, health and Safety policies
Site may also prepare a site-specific induction manual for individual departments to impart this kind of training. Site HR shall facilitate this program as per Annexure-III. Site training coordinator / HR Coordinator shall capture this training in AMITIMS.
## Basics of Good Manufacturing Practices:
- Each new joiner / existing employees engaged in manufacturing, quality control, warehousing, engineering and quality assurance functions etc. in the organization shall be provided training on basic modules of cGMP. This will include providing awareness on related regulations and its expectation on Current Good Manufacturing Practices.
- Site training coordinator shall maintain the new joiners AMITIMS profile by making necessary changes like job type, immediate supervisor etc., as necessary. Based on employee’s Job description, Site training coordinator will assign Job role to the personnel. List of available Job roles shall be maintained as per Annexure-V.

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
## Objective
The Grievance Redressal procedure at AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD. aims to reinforce the organization’s commitment towards providing fair and equitable work opportunities to all employees. The objective of the grievance resolution process is to provide employees with an easily accessible mechanism for settlement of their individual grievances.
## Scope and Applicability
This policy applies to all staff of AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD. and those of Partner organizations who are in a relationship with AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD.
Not all grievances are related to HR. Grievance covers a wider area in the Organization, particularly those which are not directly related to or in the employee’s immediate work area and people, but, in other areas which, though not frequented very often, they necessitate interaction for work purposes or for co-existence in the workplace by the employee. These areas can relate to Cafeteria, Transport, Office maintenance, Administration, infrastructure, lighting, air-conditioning, WFH support, etc.
This policy aims to focus on non-HR related areas, with the resolution responsibility involving the line manager of the department concerned. HR is certainly kept in the loop since the locus is around the employee and the incident.
HR related grievances are covered in Code of Conduct Policy, POSH Policy, Employee relationships Policy, Violence at workplace Policy, EEO&AD policy, Maternity benefits Policy, etc
AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD. will endeavor to address the grievance to the best possible extent as far as it is feasible, within its scope, is reasonable & has a larger impact to other employees, within legal / statutory ambit and is cost effective.
AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD. reserves the right to reject, cancel or postpone any grievance without assigning any reason whatsoever.
## Policy/Process
## Policy Statement
The policy is developed to provide mechanism to report Grievances related environment, labour human rights, ethics, sustainable procurement for following matter & based on analysis and investigation define action against the same through committee and apply remediation measures:
- Child Labour force Labour
- Corruption or bribery case
- Any other working condition related issues
- Affinity group or minority group having issues
- Anti-competitive practices
- Diversity discrimination or workplace harassment
- External/Internal stakeholder holder human rights
- Ethics related issues
- Human trafficking
- Money laundering
- Fraud
- Woman development related issues
- Code of Conduct Policy,
- POSH Policy,
- Employee relationships Policy,
- Violence at workplace Policy,
- Maternity benefits Policy.
- Employee Performance Appraisal & Salary review policy
- Grievance pertaining to, or arising out of, disciplinary action or appeal against such actions.
- Grievance arising out of termination/dismissal
## Grievance Statement and Policy
A grievance can be defined as any sort of dissatisfaction, which needs to be addressed in order to enable staff to function efficiently and effectively within the organization. A grievance is a sign of an employee's discontentment with his/her job or work environment or equipment / tools or workstation or relationship with colleagues.
Broadly, a grievance can be stated to be any discontentment or dissatisfaction with any aspect of the organization, except as stated in Sec.4.1 of this document, which if resolved purposefully, benefits the Organization, or employees and if not handled assertively, tactfully and empathetically, can disturb the equilibrium in the relationships and rapport levels.
AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD.’s grievance policy is designed to provide an effective procedure for resolution of problems, wherever it is feasible or possible and are within the source, resource and limits of the organization. AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD.’s policy engrains a disciplined procedure that will ensure consistent and equitable treatment to all employees.
Any grievance pertaining to HR-related matters will be dealt with by HR in accordance with the appropriate policy guidelines as mentioned in Sec.4.1 of this document, including any disciplinary actions or procedures.
## Criteria
Except for gross misconduct, no employee will be dismissed for a first breach of discipline under this policy. The level of any formal action will be dependent on the seriousness of the offence, having regard to the need for fairness and natural justice.
The procedure is internal to AMI LIFESCIENCES PVT.LTD. and does not allow for any external representation.
No disciplinary action will be taken against an employee until the case has been fully investigated.
